description: Two matching elongated lamps hang from short vertical stems beneath a shared horizontal mounting bar. Each shade has rounded upper corners and a flat bottom, with three short light rays spreading downward beneath it.
A suspended central canopy supports three bell-shaped lamp heads on descending stems. The middle lamp hangs straight down, while the two outer lamps angle outward symmetrically from the canopy.

A tall floor lamp stands on a short horizontal foot, with its central stem dividing into two curved branches. Each branch carries a matching tapered shade with a rounded top and a broad flat lower edge.
A pendant lamp hangs from a straight vertical cord above a small rounded cap and a broad domed shade. A rounded bulb projects below the shade’s flat lower rim, centered beneath the suspension.
A hanging lamp has a wide conical shade suspended from a vertical cord through a small tapered collar. A rounded bulb projects beneath the shade’s horizontal lower rim, aligned with the central cord.
